subject: Quick demo for Queuelet — follow-up from June summit
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@clearwaterllc.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in a short demo — follow-up from Summit North

Hi Tessa,

I caught your session on inference economics at Summit North — really useful content, thanks. Our team at Clearwater Analytics is exploring ways to move inference out of dev-only experiments and into a predictable production footprint. Two quick priorities for us: cost controls (batching/quantization recommendations) and a private deployment option for data residency.

We have a couple of folks who want to see a focused 30-minute walkthrough: me (Samantha), and Kevin (I cc'd him on this thread). Would next week work for you or someone on the Redwood team for a demo tailored to those two areas?

I've attached our event registration PDF that shows our attendee details and a short note on our preferred time windows.

Thanks — looking forward to a quick handshake.

Best,
Samantha Liu
Director, Data Platforms
Clearwater Analytics
Attachment: 2026-06-10-queuelet-registration.pdf (application/pdf, 48 KB)

Hi Samantha — great to meet you at the summit (virtually) and thanks for reaching out. 

Ben (AE) is looping in to run a quick 30-minute technical + commercial walkthrough that covers batching/quantization and our Private deployment options. A couple of proposed windows next week (PT):
- Tue 16 Jun, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 17 Jun, 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 18 Jun, 09:00–09:30 PT

If none of those work, share a few slots and Ben will send a calendar invite. Also, is Kevin the right person for compliance questions? If so, we can extend the invite to him as well.

Quick ask: could you confirm the stack you plan to serve from (cloud/on-prem) and whether you need SOC 2 evidence during the demo? That'll help us prep a concise checklist rather than a long security presentation.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
SDR, Redwood Inference
Schedule: https://calendly.com/tessa_morgan/15min
